title: Envoy SDS：秘密更新、確認與實際握手採用
titleEn: Envoy SDS: secret updates, acknowledgements and handshake adoption
subcategoryTitle: 授權語意、相依與一致性
summary: 建立舊新憑證公開描述、SDS版本、ACK/NACK及握手serial表；另外記錄SDS連線自身的bootstrap信任，避免用尚未取得的秘密循環建立初始信任。
summaryEn: Build old/new public certificate descriptors, SDS versions, ACK/NACK events and observed handshake serials. Record bootstrap trust for the SDS channel itself so initial connectivity does not depend circularly on a secret that has not yet been fetched.
scope: 本課採用原創合成工作負載或事件資料，在紙面、試算表與離線模型中實作。來源用於查證具名案例；數值、擾動與驗收門檻是教學假設，不是實機效能或正式環境變更規格。實驗限自己的或明確授權的隔離環境，交付可重算的證據紀錄。
scopeEn: Use original synthetic workloads or event data in paper, spreadsheet, and offline-model investigations. References establish named case context; numerical inputs, perturbations, and limits are teaching assumptions, not measured machine performance or production change specifications. Use owned or explicitly authorized isolated environments and deliver reproducible evidence records.

knowledge.title: 案例與來源邊界

knowledge.textEn: SDS supplies TLS material to Envoy. Trace publication, receipt, configuration acknowledgement and a new handshake, separating control-plane success from evidence that the data plane actually presents the replacement certificate.

knowledge.title: 可驗證的工程目標
knowledge.text: 建立舊新憑證公開描述、SDS版本、ACK/NACK及握手serial表；另外記錄SDS連線自身的bootstrap信任，避免用尚未取得的秘密循環建立初始信任。
knowledge.textEn: Build old/new public certificate descriptors, SDS versions, ACK/NACK events and observed handshake serials. Record bootstrap trust for the SDS channel itself so initial connectivity does not depend circularly on a secret that has not yet been fetched.

knowledge.title: 模型、介面與適用範圍
knowledge.text: 本課剩餘輪替時間從舊憑證到期減發布後傳播及採用延遲；ACK只能是中間證據，新連線觀察到的新serial才確認本課指定的採用結果。
knowledge.textEn: The rotation margin subtracts propagation and adoption delays from old-certificate expiry. ACK is intermediate evidence; the selected acceptance test requires a new connection to observe the replacement serial, rather than relying on a control-plane event alone.

steps.objectiveEn: Complete accept and hand over evidence for Envoy SDS · Trust contract and counterexample fixtures and produce reviewable evidence against the investigation criterion.
steps.instruction:

Ask the receiving role to repeat one check with the same inputs and retain discrepancies and open issues.
